reasoning: Round 2 changes only what QUALITY asked for, and nothing beyond it. The `computed*` maps that always held zero are gone. The `merged*[m, default: 0] += c` loops are replaced by a key-only insert (`for m in scan.*ByModel.keys where merged*[m] == nil { merged*[m] = 0 }`, AnalyticsStore.swift:102-108). The opencode-only branch now builds its zero-dollar breakdown directly with `mapValues { _ in 0 }` (:93-94). `git diff --stat` still lists exactly two files, and both tie to BUG-ART-002: Sources/AiTaskbarApp/ViewModels/AnalyticsStore.swift (the pure static `mergingOpencode` function, which is internal and reachable only through @testable, so it is not a public contract, plus the one-line call site at :136) and Tests/AiTaskbarAppTests/AnalyticsOpencodeMergeTests.swift (the new test file, unchanged since round 1). docs/audits/ is untracked audit output, not part of the fix. The diff adds no dependency, host, secret file or entitlement, and no persisted or serialized format changes. CostEstimate is built with the same fields as before. It adds no hidden cost either: the PricingTable/CostMath calls are removed and the key inserts are O(models). The docs already agree with the new behaviour (README.md:31, CLAUDE.md 'opencode is a client'), so no lockstep file is missing. The sister route is CostFooterView.swift:198, the popover footer. It shows opencode's cost as a separate line and never adds it to the vendor total, so no copied line was left unfixed. new_findings.title: Analytics shows $0 per-model breakdown rows for opencode models on pay-per-token vendors, while the popover shows the cost opencode recorded
new_findings.detail: Carried over from round 1. AnalyticsStore.swift:93-94 and :102-108 insert a 0 for each opencode model. CostFooterView.swift:198-210 shows costLast7DaysByModel for the same model. README.md:31 promises the recorded cost as a breakdown. Either show tokens only or show the recorded cost as a breakdown that is not added to the total.
